verdict.rationale: Authoring new skills is a fair axis for a skills collection, which could ship a skill-authoring spec, template, or meta-skill. The evidence lists skills for TDD, grilling, triage, repo setup, skill discovery and similar workflows, plus install and update channels. None of it documents a spec, template, or meta-skill that lets an agent author and package a new skill end to end; editable copied files and a 'which skill to use' helper do not amount to that.
